comment: lpid -> candidate crosswalk, the state analog of the federal exact-FEC-id rule (plan §2). Every entry was proposed by rollcall:oh:resolve name matching (last name = token tail + first name exact or prefix, unique both directions) against the Nov-2026 Ohio state-legislative pool, then reviewed by the operator 2026-08-23 (all 79 pairs; 74 same-district identities, 5 known cross-chamber candidacies incl. the Gayle/Nathan Manning seat swap). Hand sweep 2026-08-24 completed the file: 15 further pairs verified by name AND seat, and every remaining member carries an explicit null (reviewed, no candidate), so a no_crosswalk count now means an lpid the roster snapshot does not cover. hand additions (name variants like Mike/Michael Dovilla, members running for non-legislative offices) belong here with a note.
